Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
every three months 
as indicated by M3 in the title block
The first draft initiated 
by eng. Abdullah Elsayed M. tested by eng Abdulatif Ahmed, 
revised by quality control eng Adel Abd- El kader El Nagar at EDEPC, 
accepted by eng El Sayed Attiah Abd El Maksood general director and approved 
by eng. Fathy M Ragab Head Sector of Talkha PS.
This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general director, MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & 
quality control's general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safty category
Safty fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Tools and Equipment
Complete tool kit of screw drivers and common keys.
Digital multimeter
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes
Lubricant ( MOBILPLEX 48 )
Work to be Carried Out
Apply the 
 lubricant ( MOBILPLEX 48 ) to:
Hoist rope: 
 The condition of the wire rope is of prime importance, it should be greased 
 little but often, avoiding the use of lubricants containing petrol.
Check the
 rope 
 condition.
Rope drum: 
 By hand through the opening above the gearbox.
